summary_en: MOONBAT authorized acquisition of up to 30,000 shares (0.67% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥50 million through on-exchange purchases from November 16, 2026 to March 24, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: MOONBAT's board of directors resolved on November 13, 2026 to acquire treasury stock under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act based on the company's articles of incorporation. The company will purchase up to 30,000 ordinary shares for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥50 million during the period from November 16, 2026 to March 24, 2027. The acquisition will be conducted through on-exchange purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The 30,000 shares represent 0.67% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, calculated based on 4,507,107 shares outstanding as of October 31, 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
